overview.name: Name
overview.emailNote: A new e-mail is marked unconfirmed and gets a confirmation link.

workspaces.removeConfirm: Remove {user} from {workspace}? They lose access to it right away.
workspaces.transferText: The member you choose becomes owner; {user} stays in the workspace as admin.
workspaces.noMembers: Nobody else is in this workspace. Add someone first, or delete it together with the account.
workspaces.empty: Not a member of any workspace.

security.resetEmailText: The person gets the same link as “Forgot your password?” (valid 2 hours).
security.temporaryText: A random password, shown once. The person is signed out and must choose their own right after signing in.
security.temporaryConfirm: Set a temporary password for {email}? Every session of this person ends.
security.temporaryShown: Give this password to the person through a safe channel. It is shown only now and is not stored anywhere readable.
security.signOutText: Ends every session on every device; the person signs in again.
security.reset2faConfirm: Turn off two-step sign-in for {email}? Do this only after checking who is asking (for example a lost phone).
security.disableConfirm: Disable {email}? The person is signed out and cannot sign in until you enable the account again.
security.enableConfirm: Enable {email}? The person can sign in again.
security.makeAdminConfirm: Give {email} full control of the platform, every user and every workspace?
security.lastAdmin: This is the last active platform administrator: it cannot be disabled or demoted.

apps.revokeConfirm: Revoke every API key and connected app of {email}? Tools using them stop working right away.

danger.impersonateText: Opens the app as {name} for 30 minutes, to see what they see. You cannot delete anything or touch their password, e-mail, two-step sign-in or keys, and the admin area stays closed. Every change is recorded with your name. It ends when you press End, sign out, or after 30 minutes.
danger.impersonateConfirm: View the app as {email} for 30 minutes?
danger.noImpersonate: Platform administrators, disabled and deleted accounts cannot be viewed as.
danger.exportText: Everything the platform keeps about this person, for a GDPR access or portability request.
danger.deleteText: Anonymizes the account (name, e-mail, photo, password), removes it from every workspace and revokes sessions, keys and apps. Invoices and audit records stay. This cannot be undone.
danger.transfer: {name}: only owner, {n} other members. Transfer the ownership in the Workspaces tab.
danger.deleteWs: {name}: nobody else is in it. It will be deleted with everything in it.
danger.isSelf: This is your own account: delete it from your account center.
